scenario: A user thinks about comparing their beginner artwork with a friend's experienced work.
memory_focus: They want to measure progress against their own earlier attempts.
detours: Discuss what makes practising enjoyable, then how to handle a frustrating session.

scenario: A person reflects on a conversation where a friend offered ideas before listening fully.
memory_focus: The user wants to ask for listening first, while remaining open to ideas later.
detours: Discuss choosing a calm moment, then recognising the friend's likely good intentions without assuming them.

scenario: Someone considers whether to return to an abandoned community activity.
memory_focus: They want to attend once before deciding on any regular commitment.
detours: Discuss handling uncertainty, then how to greet familiar people after a long absence.

scenario: A user reflects on feeling rushed when making small everyday choices.
memory_focus: They want permission to take a moment, not a detailed decision system.
detours: Discuss noticing outside pressure, then responding when someone is waiting.

scenario: A resident changes their mind about their role in a community talent evening.
memory_focus: They correct their earlier plan: they will introduce performers, not perform themselves.
detours: Discuss keeping transitions smooth, then how to welcome a nervous participant.

scenario: A learner revises how they want help with a new practical skill.
memory_focus: They first request a complete demonstration, then prefer a brief example followed by practice.
detours: Discuss making room to work, then recovering from a small mistake.

scenario: A coworker corrects their availability for a team brainstorming session.
memory_focus: They can attend the first half only, not the whole session.
detours: Discuss how to keep ideas flowing, then how to include someone who joins late.

scenario: A volunteer updates their preference for handling donated craft materials.
memory_focus: They initially offer to sort paints but change to sorting brushes.
detours: Discuss arranging a work table, then how to welcome another helper.

scenario: The user recounts a misunderstanding while arranging a call across time zones.
memory_focus: Their friend meant 7 p.m. in the friend's time zone, not the user's.
detours: Discuss what they hope to catch up about; then discuss how long it has been since they last spoke. Finally ask whose time zone the proposed hour referred to.

scenario: A person corrects who will teach a skill at a neighbourhood gathering.
memory_focus: They initially say they will teach folding; they clarify that their friend will demonstrate while they assist.
detours: Discuss making room for observers, then welcoming beginners.

scenario: A user changes the intended audience for a practice conversation.
memory_focus: They first plan to practise with a group, then decide on a one-to-one conversation.
detours: Discuss finding a natural opening, then handling a pause.

scenario: A resident revises the purpose of a shared community table.
memory_focus: They first suggest displaying finished crafts, then choose a table for works in progress.
detours: Discuss arranging seats, then inviting people to share ideas without pressure.
